summary: Shows json_query examples: all cluster names, all server names, ports filtered by cluster, joining ports into a string, and quoting literals with backticks or doubled single quotes.
questions: How do I extract all names from a list in JSON with json_query?
How do I filter JSON items by a field value with json_query?
How do I quote string literals in a JMESPath query in YAML?

answer_card.title: json_query examples
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
loop: "{{ domain_definition | community.general.json_query('domain.cluster[*].name') }}"
```

Filter by field (a variable keeps it readable):

```yaml
vars:
  q: "domain.server[?cluster=='cluster1'].port"
loop: "{{ domain_definition | community.general.json_query(q) }}"
```

Backticks avoid escaping: `json_query('domain.server[?cluster==`cluster1`].port') | join(', ')`. Or double single quotes in YAML: `''cluster1''`.
